name: Innkeep Ragna
title: The Silver Flagon
examine: A bar rag over one shoulder and the whole city's news behind her eyes. Nothing said in the Flagon stays in the Flagon unless she decides it does.
lines: Beds, board, and the news first. The news is free. The beds are not, and don't let anyone tell you the board is.
Signy lodges in my guest wing and cooks in her own kitchen, and the day those two facts trade places this city falls apart.
Dunna keeps the inn at the ford and I keep the one at the top. We split the road's gossip at the middle waystation like honest smugglers.
